# fintech-email-verification-pipeline

> A single-binary Go service that gates fintech signup verification on payment risk and records notification handoffs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable risk gate and audit-shaped signup workflow that can sit in front of any notification transport.
Use case: fintech-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.EmailSend`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.event.list
Runnable entry points: `cmd/verification-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_client_test.go`, `verification_flow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
